title: Premiership Psycho
tagline: American Psycho for the hundred-grand-a-week generation.
blurb: Kev King has the world at his feet – top-flight football, where brands are all, lifestyle is god, and there is nothing and no one that money can’t buy.

Relegated, benched and paranoid about his girlfriend’s rising profile, Kev fights his way back to the top and leaves a trail of destruction behind him. A compelling, hilarious and horrible insight into celebrity culture, and a savage satire of contemporary football.

quotes.text: American Psycho for the hundred-grand-a-week generation.
If you get it, you’ll love it… Either way, you’ll have a hoot.
As with all good satire, this dystopian vision inspires laughter and loathing in equal measure.
